description: This file contains PHP functions for generating network information in XML, HTML, and WML formats, specifically for a system info script. It defines functions to output network device stats and formats them for different display types.

methods.name: xml_network
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing network device statistics.

methods.name: html_network
methods.description: Generates an HTML table displaying network device statistics.

methods.name: wml_network
methods.description: Generates a WML card with network device statistics.
